instruction.name: xvmaddwev.q.du
instruction.description: Multiply the even-positioned unsigned 64-bit elements in `b` and the corresponding unsigned 64-bit elements in `c`, extending both to 128-bit, and add the product to the 128-bit elements in `a`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 6.99; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 30 independent accumulators, shared sources

throughput.notes: `vd` is an accumulator, so one lane can only issue once per its 7-cycle latency and an 8-lane body measures that feedback (7.0 cycles for 8 instructions, 0.875 CPI). With 30 independent accumulators and two shared sources the unit sustains 30/15.00 = 2.00 instructions per cycle. Keep the body inside L1I: 30 instructions at unroll 1000 is a 120 KiB body and measures 23.4 cycles, while the same body at unroll 200 is 24 KiB and measures 15.00.
